cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says a rule on state data is in force: the data governance strategy, with its rules on local hosting and classification, was reported validated in November 2026, not adopted.
cells.note: The data governance strategy setting rules on local hosting and classification of state data was validated by November 2026 (TCD-005), and the national data centre awaits certification (TCD-002), so stage 2. A validated strategy is not a policy in force, so not 3.
